rows.answer: Using the SPX panic regime (Composite Panic Index above 64) over the 2021-05-17 to 2024-06-28 window, there were 111 panic-regime days. Forward 1-month (21 trading day) returns averaged 2.86% with a 73.0% win rate and a median of 4.32% (range -10.32% to 12.92%). Forward 3-month (63 trading day) returns averaged only 0.47%, with a 48.6% win rate and median of -0.04% (range -13.03% to 12.59%). The last panic-regime day in the sample was 2023-03-17. So the short-horizon bounce was reliable historically, but the 3-month edge was essentially flat.

rows.answer: For SMH in 2022 the two detectors disagree in character. The scipy hindsight method labels 8 peaks, led by 2022-05-09 (Panic Index 91.94) and 2022-03-07 (91.55), plus 2022-10-12 (85.31), 2022-06-16 (82.99) and 2022-09-27 (82.76); 2022-12-12 (44.7) is the only sub-64 label. The realtime detector fires 13 causal signals, highest at 2022-03-09 (81.66), with the rest clustered 67.97–79.8, e.g. 2022-10-13 (79.8) and 2022-05-19 (76.59). Realtime entries sit a few days to weeks after each hindsight peak and below it in level, since confirmation waits for a retreat from the local max; realtime also signals repeatedly around one episode. The latest regime is neutral at 47.27 (percentile 53.5), so the signal holds 100%, vs 100% before.

Powell said the framework would look familiar but be faster.
